tokens.name: bracket-lift
tokens.usage: How far an inline [ or ] character (inside card text) is raised from the baseline (position: relative; top), so it sits centered on the words between.

tokens.name: bracket-width
tokens.usage: Width of a drawn headline bracket (the pair that encloses a headline block), in the headline's em.

tokens.name: bracket-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of a drawn headline bracket, in the headline's em.

tokens.name: bracket-gap
tokens.usage: Space between a drawn headline bracket and the text it encloses, in the headline's em.

tokens.name: bracket-top
tokens.usage: Margin above a drawn headline bracket (negative: it rises above the block), in the headline's em. Derived from the display face (Nimbus Sans Narrow Bold, line-height 1): the cap height is 0.718em and the baseline sits 0.722em down the line box, so -0.146em puts the bracket's top 0.15em (one stroke) above the first line's cap top.

tokens.name: bracket-bottom
tokens.usage: Margin below a drawn headline bracket (it ends just under the block), in the headline's em. From the same measurements: 0.128em ends the bracket 0.15em (one stroke) past the last line's baseline, so it is centered on the capitals for one or two lines.
